Select exact IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against human BTK (CHEMBL5251). Require compounds to have a canonical SMILES string and activities to have a PubMed ID or DOI. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays and target_dictionary. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to enforce SMILES presence. Join docs on activities.doc_id to obtain PubMed ID or DOI. Join compound_records on activities.record_id to retrieve compound_key. Return all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Output columns: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
